spec.name: Furniture Scarecrow
spec.description: A friendly pumpkin scarecrow on a grounded wooden post, wearing a broad straw hat and a patched purple coat with outstretched sleeves and a split hem. Painted eyes and a gentle smile face negative Z. Thirteen connected, axis-aligned cuboids fit within the requested furniture bounds.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: friendly pumpkin-headed scarecrow with straw hat, patched purple coat and wooden post. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
